title: Kissed Crispy Irish Lamb Brochette
description: A winey and snappy Irish dish featuring sweet sherry, this broiled lamb brochette is a perfect hangover cure with Mediterranean-friendly flavors. It combines the richness of lamb with the sweetness of sherry and the crunch of a crispy exterior.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sweet sherry, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a broiler pan and broil for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the brochette hot with lemon wedges on the side.
Garnish with additional rosemary sprigs if desired.
